item.title: Pearl Thusi Debuts Musical Journey With "Sodwa" A Tribute To African Resilience, Cultural Heritage, And Love - SlikourOnLife
item.description: Internationally acclaimed actress, entrepreneur, DJ, and cultural innovator, Pearl Thusi, marks a transformative milestone with her debut single “Sodwa” featuring Maskandi legend Ihashi Elimhlophe and contributions from DJ Melzi. The track is a profound exploration of cultural identity, intergenerational connection, and the universal language of love. “Sodwa” transcends conventional boundaries, seamlessly blending Afro-house, Amapiano, Maskandi, […]

item.title: Durban’s Gqom Masters Goldmax and DJ Tira Present Voices Of Gqom a Powerful Tribute to the Culture - SlikourOnLife
item.description: There are moments in South African music when two generations meet to create something that shifts the culture. Voices Of Gqom, the long-awaited joint album from Goldmax and DJ Tira, arrives as one of those moments. The pair draw from the heart of their city, the pulse of the streets, and the stories of everyday life […]

item.title: Lex LaFoy Releases Music Video for ‘Tebogo Mahange’ - SlikourOnLife
item.description: Lex LaFoy has released the official music video for her single 'Tebogo Mahange,' delivering a high-energy visual that mirrors the track’s driving rhythm. Featuring sequences of running, choreography, and dynamic urban and outdoor scenes, the video captures the song’s themes of movement, perseverance, and community.

item.title: Roiii Reflects on K.O’s One Man Show and His Impact on Him and SA Hip Hop - SlikourOnLife
item.description: Rapper Roiii reflected on K.O’s recent solo show, highlighting the veteran artist’s role in shaping his career and his broader impact on South African hip hop. He emphasized K.O’s mentorship and support in developing emerging talent, noting how the performance showcased both his artistry and his influence on the next generation of musicians.

item.title: Saudi Celebrates Two Years of ‘Msotra Don’t Die’ Album - SlikourOnLife
item.description: Saudi marked the second anniversary of his album Msotra Dont Die, reflecting on the project that has continued to shape his artistic journey. Two years later, the album remains a defining piece of his catalogue and continues to resonate with listeners who connected with its themes and sound.

item.title: Stogie T Celebrates as ‘ANOMY' Debuted Number One on SA Hip Hop Charts - SlikourOnLife
item.description: Stogie T has achieved a major milestone with his latest album, 'ANOMY,' which debuted at number one on both the Apple Music and Spotify South African Hip-Hop charts. The album’s lead single, 'Four Horsemen,' broke first-day streaming records for a hip-hop song in South Africa, surpassing the previous benchmark set by Drake. He extended his gratitude to the collaborators who helped bring the project to life.
